summary: Miles de personas participaron el jueves 12 de febrero en la primera gran manifestación de la oposición desde la captura de Nicolás Maduro en un operativo estadounidense. La movilización tuvo lugar el día en que el Parlamento tenía previsto aprobar una ley de amnistía que habría conllevado la liberación masiva de opositores presos. Pero el debate finalmente…

title: Tribunal Superior británico declara ilegal considerar como terrorista al grupo 'Palestine Action'
summary: La decisión del Gobierno de Reino Unido, del pasado julio, sobre clasificar al grupo de protesta 'Palestine Action' como organización terrorista fue ilegal, según dictaminó este viernes 13 de febrero el Tribunal Superior británico. La Policía del país arrestó a más de 2.000 manifestantes pacíficos por sostener carteles que declaraban su apoyo al movimiento.

title: CAN 2027 : Motsepe promet que la compétition aura bien lieu en temps et en heure en Afrique de l'Est
summary: À l'issue d'un comité exécutif de la Confédération africaine de football (CAF) en Tanzanie, le président de l'instance, Patrice Motsepe, a fait taire les rumeurs de report : la CAN 2027 ne sera pas décalée et sera bien coorganisée par la Tanzanie, le Kenya et l'Ouganda.

title: Canadian, UK finance groups freeze new DP World deals over CEO’s Epstein emails
summary: Financial groups in Canada and the United Kingdom have paused future ventures with DP World after newly released US Justice Department documents revealed yearslong correspondence between CEO Sultan Ahmed bin Sulayem and Jeffrey Epstein. The emails included references to pornography and escorts, drawing scrutiny to the Dubai-based logistics giant.

title: Bangladesh Nationalist Party claims victory in landmark post-Hasina election
summary: Bangladesh’s opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), led by Tarique Rahman, was projected to win a landslide in the first election since a deadly 2024 uprising, local television channels said on Friday. Senior BNP leader Ruhul Kabir Rizvi claimed a “sweeping victory”.

title: Fraude à la billetterie du Louvre : neuf interpellations et plus de 10 millions d'euros de préjudice
summary: Neuf personnes ont été interpellées mardi, soupçonnées d'escroquerie à la billetterie au détriment du musée du Louvre et du château de Versailles, a indiqué le parquet de Paris jeudi. Pour le musée parisien, le préjudice est estimé "à plus de 10 millions d'euros".

title: Venezuela postpones vote on amnesty bill to protect political dissidents
summary: Venezuelan lawmakers on Thursday postponed a landmark amnesty bill meant to halt the use of courts against dissenters after failing to agree on its implementation. Thousands rallied in Caracas demanding the release of political prisoners. The bill would clear charges against opponents of former leaders Nicolas Maduro and Hugo Chavez.

title: Marco Rubio leads US delegation with warmer tone at Munich summit
summary: The Munich Security Conference opens in Munich, Germany, with EU‑US relations and NATO cooperation at the forefront after U.S. tensions over Greenland and Ukraine. Secretary of State Marco Rubio leads the U.S. delegation with a warmer, more reassuring tone, while talks will also cover European defence and global security challenges.

title: French police arrest two Louvre museum employees over ‘large-scale’ ticket fraud
summary: French police have arrested nine people, including two employees working at the Louvre museum in Paris, suspected of involvement in a “large-scale” ticket fraud ring, a source familiar with the case said Thursday. The fraud scheme was allegedly launched in the summer of 2024 and is thought to have mainly targeted Chinese tourists.

title: La justice britannique juge l'interdiction de Palestine Action "disproportionnée"
summary: Au Royaume-Uni, la justice a estimé que l'interdiction par le gouvernement britannique du groupe militant Palestine Action, classé terroriste en juillet, était "disproportionnée" et a porté atteinte à la liberté d'expression. Le gouvernement a fait appel.

title: L'adoption de la loi d'amnistie générale prend plus de temps que prévu au Venezuela
summary: L'adoption de la loi d'amnistie générale a été reportée à une date ultérieure, jeudi, car les députés vénézuéliens n'ont pas réussi à se mettre d'accord. De son côté, la présidente par intérim Delcy Rodriguez a promis "des élections libres et équitables".

title: EU leaders back major economic overhaul to counter pressure from US, China and Russia
summary: European Union leaders on Thursday agreed on an action plan to overhaul the bloc’s economy and boost competitiveness amid pressure from US President Donald Trump, China and Russia. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said the March plan would upgrade energy grids, deepen financial integration and ease merger rules.

title: Más petróleo, menos sanciones y una pronta cita: Venezuela y EE. UU. apuntan ahora a una buena sintonía
summary: En una entrevista con NBC, la presidenta interina de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, aseguró haber recibido una invitación para ir a Estados Unidos. El viaje se concretaría después de "avanzar" con la "cooperación" entre ambos países, una relación que el mandatario estadounidense Donald Trump calificó en sus redes sociales de "extraordinaria".

title: Whatever it takes? EU in race to shore up sovereignty
summary: Can Europe man the ramparts on its own? As the US war secretary snubbed a NATO defence ministers' meeting in Brussels, EU leaders converged on the 16th-century Alden Biesen castle in Belgium's Limburg province to answer former Italian prime minister Mario Draghi's call for a "big bazooka" approach to reform and competitiveness.

title: JO 2026 : le biathlète français Quentin Fillon Maillet sacré champion olympique en sprint
summary: Quentin Fillon Maillet a remporté l'épreuve du sprint (10 km) en biathlon, vendredi, aux Jeux olympiques d'hiver de Milan-Cortina. Il s'agit de son quatrième titre olympique, après le relais mixte lors de ces Jeux, la poursuite et l'individuel en 2022.

title: Exportadores de flores colombianos afectados por la caída del dolar
summary: 🇨🇴🌹 A pocos días de San Valentín, los trabajadores del sector floricultor en Colombia redoblan sus esfuerzos para lograr exportar más de 900 millones de tallos al país norteamericano. Sin embargo, la debilidad del dólar, los aranceles estadounidenses y los cambios en las normas laborales tienen en alerta a los exportadores de flores.

title: En direct : suivez le décollage de l'astronaute française Sophie Adenot pour l'ISS
summary: Après des mois de préparation et deux reports de dernière minute, Sophie Adenot et les trois autres astronautes de Crew-12 s'apprêtent à décoller vendredi pour rejoindre la Station spatiale internationale (ISS). Suivez notre direct sur France 24.

title: Milano-Cortina Olympics: France’s Miradoli takes Super-G silver
summary: Romane Miradoli won silver in the Super-G at the Milan-Cortina 2026 Olympic Games. At 31, the French skier claimed her first Olympic medal – the first for a French woman in Alpine skiing in 24 years. She was beaten by Italy’s Federica Brignone, who triumphed just 10 months after suffering a serious left leg injury.

title: La Unión Europea promete reformas urgentes para competir con EE. UU. y China
summary: Líderes europeos reunidos en un castillo belga coincidieron en que la economía del bloque necesita un impulso inmediato frente a la presión de grandes potencias económicas globales. Sin embargo, persisten divisiones sobre deuda conjunta, proteccionismo y el envío de fondos a Ucrania para asistirla mientras está en guerra.

title: Indian farmers protest trade deal with US
summary: Indian farmers and trade unions staged a day of nationwide strike and protest over a recently announced trade deal with the United States. While the government says measures to safeguard the country's agriculture sector have been put in place, farmers worry the agreement will lower barriers for US farm products.

title: Décollage de la fusée SpaceX vers l’ISS : "c'est une aventure familiale"
summary: "C'est une aventure familiale" : l’astronaute Raphaël Liégeois nous explique les étape des procédures, les conditions de travail dans l'espace, et l’avenir de la station spatiale internationale, en direct de la Cité des sciences à Paris.

title: 'A born astronaut': France's Sophie Adenot makes history with flight to space
summary: France's Sophie Adenot became only the second French woman to fly to space on Friday as her crew of four rocketed towards the International Space Station for an eight-month mission on board the orbiting laboratory, where a medical evacuation earlier this year left a skeleton crew of just three astronauts.

title: Macron courts controversy by appointing loyalists to lead key French institutions
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron on Wednesday nominated his budget minister Amélie de Montchalin to lead the country’s top audit body – a position she could hold for decades to come. Critics say this part of a growing bid by Macron to lock down national institutions and leave a mark beyond the presidency.

title: North Korea warns of ‘terrible response’ over South Korean drone flights
summary: North Korea on Friday warned of a “terrible response” if more drones cross its border from the South, escalating tensions despite Seoul’s efforts to improve ties. Pyongyang said it shot down a surveillance drone last month. Kim Yo Jong cautioned that further incursions would trigger severe consequences.

title: Derrière les JO de Milan : 2,4 millions de mètres cubes de neige artificielle
summary: Dans Derrière l’image, on prend le temps de décrypter une image et tout ce qu’il y a derrière. Malvina Raud, journaliste à ENTR, décrypte une photo qui a été prise aux JO hier, lors de l’épreuve de biathlon en individuel sur 15km.

title: France eyes new space record with 9-month ISS mission for Sophie Adenot
summary: Sophie Adenot is preparing for a nine-month mission aboard the International Space Station, aiming to set a new record for a French astronaut in orbit. She will carry out more than 200 scientific and medical experiments in microgravity while completing intensive training and maintenance work in space.

title: Apple's stock dropped 5% on Thursday, its worst day since April, following FTC scrutiny of Apple News and reports about delays with Siri (Jennifer Elias/CNBC)
summary: Jennifer Elias / CNBC: Apple's stock dropped 5% on Thursday, its worst day since April, following FTC scrutiny of Apple News and reports about delays with Siri — Apple just wrapped up its worst day on the stock market since April after reports surfaced about delays with Siri and as the company's news app faced regulatory scrutiny.

title: Bangladesh election raises expectations of a new political era
summary: As Bangladeshis cast their ballots on Thursday in their first free election in 17 years, many are hoping for an end to corruption, greater safety and security, improved economic conditions, and real structural changes in their daily lives, as explained by FRANCE 24's journalist Navodita Kumari.

title: ACROSS AFRICA: Wined Up - A continent uncorked.
summary: As one of the biggest events in the global wine scene wraps up in Paris Georja is joined by Nigerian vine virtuoso, Chinedu Rita Rosa. The French industry is struggling but Africa's growing, young, cosmopolitan middle class is the perfect terroir for producers hoping to cultivate new markets.

title: La France et la Norvège signent un accord pour soutenir l'Ukraine, Oslo achète des bombes françaises
summary: Un accord entre la Paris et Oslo a été lancé, jeudi, pour soutenir militairement l'Ukraine face à l'invasion russe. Le ministère norvégien de la Défense a annoncé l'achat d'un "gros volume" de bombes planantes françaises.

title: UK's decision to ban Palestine Action as terrorist group was unlawful, court rules
summary: The UK government's decision last July to ban the protest group Palestine Action as a terrorist organisation was unlawful, Britain's High Court ruled Friday. British police have arrested more than 2,000 peaceful protesters for holding signs declaring their support for the proscribed group.

title: Informe desde Santiago: Chile enviará ayuda humanitaria a Cuba
summary: El Gobierno de Chile anunció una donación a Unicef para que la agencia de las Naciones Unidas pueda utilizarla en Cuba para garantizar servicios básicos de la población, que se encuentra en una situación crítica tras el endurecimiento del bloqueo por parte de Estados Unidos. Informe de Alberto Peña.

title: Comment une mise en scène d'un Youtubeur a été prise pour un vrai kidnapping en plein Paris
summary: Un entrepreneur en cryptomonnaie aurait été kidnappé à Paris mercredi 11 février, affirment des internautes qui partagent plusieurs vidéos du prétendu rapt. L'enlèvement était en fait une mise en scène d'un Youtubeur.

title: L'actu en dessin : Donald Trump accentue la pression énergétique sur Cuba
summary: Privé de son fournisseur vénézuélien, Cuba a été contraint d'imposer des mesures drastiques pour rationner le pétrole alors que Donald Trump a durci les sanctions pour asphyxier économiquement le régime communiste.

title: La astronauta francesa Sophie Adenot despega hacia la Estación Espacial Internacional
summary: La NASA y SpaceX lanzaron a cuatro astronautas a la Estación Espacial Internacional este viernes 13 de febrero, reemplazando a la tripulación que partió anticipadamente en la primera evacuación médica en la historia de la estación. Sophie Adenot es la segunda mujer francesa en viajar al espacio.

title: Espaldarazo al cambio climático: Trump impulsa derogación de limitación legal a emisión de gases
summary: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, anunció un nuevo impulso a los combustibles fósiles. El mandatario prometió que el Ejército estadounidense priorizará la electricidad generada con la quema de carbón, asegurando que van a acabar con "las restricciones ambientales de la era Biden".

summary: Pékin a protesté, vendredi, après l’arrestation d’un capitaine de pêche chinois par le Japon. Cet incident ravive les différends territoriaux entre la Chine et Japon, et les crispations autour de Taïwan.

title: Macron calls for 'mandatory electoral bans' for people guilty of anti-Semitic or racist acts
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron on Friday called for those found guilty of anti-Semitic or racist acts or remarks to receive "mandatory electoral bans". Macron was speaking on the 20-year anniversary of the kidnapping, torture and murder of French Jewish man Ilan Halimi.

title: Paris's Cité des Sciences soars with excitement over Crew‑12 launch
summary: The Cité des Sciences in Paris watched the Crew‑12 launch with excitement as astronauts headed to the ISS. Raphael Liégois, French astronaut, shared his insights on the mission with France 24’s Claire Paccalin, highlighting the thrill and significance of the lift‑off.

title: Troye Sivan’s ‘Blue Neighbourhood’ 10th Anniversary Edition Includes ‘Strawberries & Cigarettes,’ ‘Swimming Pools’: Stream It Now
summary: Sivan celebrates the milestone anniversary with "Blue Neighbourhood - Ten Years On," which gathers two additional tracks and features reimagined art from original illustrator Hsiao-Ron Cheng.

title: Japan seizes Chinese fishing boat and arrests captain
summary: Japan seized a Chinese fishing boat Thursday and arrested its captain, authorities said Friday, alleging that the boat was sailing inside Japan's exclusive economic zone. Beijing has called on Tokyo to respect the rights of the vessel's Chinese crew members.
